text:
Hey HN! I'm an indie hacker, and one thing I've always struggled with is consistently creating content to promote my projects on social media. an of course i found it not fun todo as a developer.

Building the product is one thing. Coming up with social media ideas, creating visuals, writing captions, and doing it all consistently is another.

So I built Postraid to automate your social media marketing and you just need to generate your monthly batch content and connect your social media accounts and then schedule for whole months.

Content types are: Slideshows, Meme videos, Reaction + demo type video
title: Show HN: I built Postraid to help founders create social media content with AI
